series_level_findings: (1) THE ARCHIVE: icpcvn.github.io (GitHub repo icpcvn/icpcvn.github.io, formerly acmicpc-vietnam.github.io; Wayback has it from 2020-08-05) is the de-facto ICPC Vietnam archive: national-round scoreboards for 2016 (DOMjudge at 210.245.95.61, 'NATIONAL ONLINE 2016 hosted by Nha Trang University', winner BK.Juniors/HUST — 2016 is not in this brief but the row exists) and 2021–2025 (static VNOJ exports), problems PDFs 2016–2025, editorials 2017–2019, and links to the Kattis sites for 2017–2020. It has NOTHING for the 2012–2015 nationals (only 2015/regional). (2) PLATFORM HISTORY: 2012–2013 online on FPT University's exam system (FPT Hoa Lac 'hosted the online final for the second time' in 2013); 2014 problems by VNOI people with CF Gym mirrors 100499 (First Round, 12 Oct 2014) and 100541 (Second Round); 2016 DOMjudge; 2017–2020 Kattis (vietnam-nationalYY.kattis.com, with open mirrors: vietnam-national17-open, b256wf, vietnam-national19open, vietnam-national20open); 2021–2025 VNOJ oj.vnoi.info/contest/icpcYY_national (official runs, 08:00–13:00 +07, ranking at /ranking/); 2026 moved to icpc.vnoi.info. (3) STRUCTURE: three regional online rounds (North/South/Central, Oct) -> national round (late Oct/Nov, Sunday) -> ICPC Asia Vietnam regional with OLP (Nov/Dec). 2014 is the anomaly: no Vietnam regional site; the on-site 'Second Round' at IUH HCMC (28–31 Oct 2014, 107 Vietnamese teams) selected the top 10 for ICPC Asia Phuket — this explains the catalogue's parent None / 'apc' and the two cms_ids. (4) DATE CORRECTIONS: catalogue dates look like the Saturday practice day for 2020 (actual Sun 15 Nov 2020), 2023 (Sun 5 Nov 2023), 2024 (Sun 17 Nov 2024), 2025 (Sun 9 Nov 2025); 2017–2019, 2021, 2022 match. (5) PEOPLE/SOURCES: Codeforces user I_love_Hoang_Yen (problem setter/organiser, announcements 2014–2020: entries 14187, 14233, 16911, 55561, 63147, 71040, 84587); Nguyễn Long (VAIP, contest director); contacts acmicpc.vietnam@gmail.com, olpvietnam@vaip.vn; VNOI Facebook facebook.com/vnoi.wiki. olp.vn (VAIP) is the official site but its results page only embeds recent Google-Drive files and Wayback's availability API finds no pre-2026 snapshot of www.olp.vn/. (6) Team counts in the catalogue match press figures for 2013 (164), 2014 (107 = Second Round), 2015 (161), 2017 (199), 2019 (262), 2021 (363), 2022 (377), 2023 (414 vs 415), 2024 (446), 2025 (490 vs 491); 2012's 216 vs DTU's '~160' unresolved.
